dct_description_sm: Abstract: The street centerlines transportation coverage is a polyline layer representing the center of road and streets righst of way within the City of Somerville, Massachusetts.

Purpose: This dataset was developed to depict the street centerlines of all streets within the City of Somerville. These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on transportation management functions (e.g. maintenance of road networks), routing applications as well as in plots where inclusion of road networks are deemed appropriate. Other user applications may focus on planning, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output).

Supplemental information: Road centerlines captured here usually represent the center of the road right of way. Exceptions to this are freeways and large divided highways which are represented by double lines. The center of physical roadway pavement may or may not represent the center of the road right of way. Road right of ways may taper or change width.
